seo.description: See how Mysa Living and Aster & Row use Steps AI as an AI sales agent, in their own words.

hero.title: How stores use an AI sales agent to help customers choose.
hero.body: Customers describe what they need in their own words. These businesses use Steps AI to point shoppers to products that make sense, including after the team has gone home.

stories.attribution: Anika Rao | Head of Digital | Mysa Living
stories.excerpt: StepsAI is good at the questions that don’t fit neatly into filters. People will say what they need, their budget, maybe what they’ve bought before, and StepsAI can point them to a few products that actually make sense.
A lot of our customers shop and message us after hours. StepsAI handles most of those questions now, so we’re not coming back every morning to a backlog. For a team of six, that’s been really useful.

capabilities.title: What the AI sales agent does.

items.title: Recommend from your catalogue
items.body: The agent suggests products from your connected store based on need, budget and style.

items.title: Check stock and share checkout
items.body: With Shopify or WooCommerce connected, the agent checks availability and sends a checkout link.

items.title: Answer after hours
items.body: Questions that arrive in the evening get an answer straight away instead of waiting for the morning.
